reviews.title: Good at everything but export.
reviews.text:
If your goal is to keep everything that you do on this app within this app then it's great but if your goal is to export the data that you collect with this app, you will be annoyed and disappointed. 

The way that it handles exports is very limited the format options also limited and it even lacks the ability to put out a clean simple text document.

The fact that this is incapable of pumping out a premade clean PDF is pretty baffling.   I actually don't understand the point of this app if it handles exporting the data that it collects so badly.

Until this app dev team decides to finally give good exporting tools and options this review will stay bad.

reviews.title: Feedback on Huge Price Increase for Hours Subscription
reviews.text:
I’ve been a long-time user (2010) of Hours and really appreciate how well it helps me track my time. However, I was surprised to see the annual subscription jump from $9.99/year to $47.99/year — nearly a 5× increase in price.

While I understand the need for sustainable pricing, such a large increase is difficult for many users to absorb, especially when competing time-tracking apps offer strong features at more moderate price points. It would be great to hear more about the reasoning behind this change, and if there’s any plan to offer:

A grandfathered discount for existing users,

A lifetime purchase option, or

More clearly tiered functionality tied to the price increase.

I’d love to continue using Hours, but this pricing shift may push me to explore alternatives if options with similar value are available.

Thanks for your consideration and for the great app!

The 2 stars is for the 4.8x price increase!!
